notes: Covers machine types 20XX and 20XW. The power adapter plug and the camera vary by configuration, so each part names its configuration.

gaps: Not recorded: memory (16 GB soldered LPDDR4x on 20XW004RUS), M.2 SSD, keyboard, fingerprint reader, CPU and base cover, which have no matching part type or no source read.
method: Specs come from three Lenovo PSREF sheets for 20XW004RUS, 20XW0026GE and 20XW0050BM (copies on third-party sites), the Lenovo X1 Carbon Gen 9 and Yoga Gen 6 user guide (second edition, July 2021), and a ManualsLib copy of the Yoga Gen 6 and Carbon Gen 9 hardware maintenance manual (copyright 2021...
Which lists machine types 20XX and 20XW on viewer page 5.
Years 2021 comes from the PSREF announce dates (2021-03-02 and 2021-04-20).

comps.spec: Integrated 57 Wh battery (PSREF 20XW004RUS; the same 57 Wh is listed on 20XW0026GE and 20XW0050BM)
65 W USB-C ac power adapter. PSREF 20XW004RUS lists a 2-pin plug; PSREFs 20XW0026GE and 20XW0050BM list a Slim 3-pin plug
14-inch WUXGA 1920x1200 IPS panel, 400 nits, anti-glare, 10-point multi-touch (PSREF 20XW004RUS)
Stereo speakers, 2 W x2 and 0.8 W x2, Dolby Atmos (PSREF 20XW004RUS)
Thermal fan assembly, item 9 in the Carbon Gen 9 FRU table; the page read gives no size, rating or part number
Coin-cell battery; checkout reads +2.5 to +3.2 V dc between the red wire and black ground, and says to replace the coin-cell battery if out of range; chemistry not stated
Ports on 20XW004RUS (PSREF): 1x HDMI 2.0, 1x USB 3.2 Gen 1, 1x USB 3.2 Gen 1 always-on, 2x Thunderbolt 4 / USB4 40 Gbps, 1x 3.5 mm headphone/mic combo jack
Wireless WAN card, for selected models; removal needs the base cover off and the built-in battery disabled first
WLAN antenna; the LCD unit comes with the WLAN antenna
Wireless-WAN antenna assembly, item 11 in the Carbon Gen 9 FRU table, for selected models
